progression.narrative: The performance opens on A3 and dwells most on C in Zangule-ye Saghir and Kabir. The line peaks at C5 (518.4 Hz) at 1:09.2. It closes on F3, not the tonic (F3 → G3 → C5 → G3 → F3 → F3).
